examples: She tried to avoid eye contact with her ex-boyfriend at the party.
او تلاش کرد در مهمانی از برقراری تماس چشمی با دوست‌پسر سابقش اجتناب کند.
Doctors advise patients to avoid sugary drinks if they want to lose weight.
پزشکان به بیماران توصیه می‌کنند اگر می‌خواهند وزن کم کنند، از نوشیدنی‌های شیرین اجتناب کنند.
We left early to avoid the heavy traffic that usually builds up after work.
ما زود حرکت کردیم تا از ترافیک سنگینی که معمولاً بعد از کار شکل می‌گیرد، اجتناب کنیم.
miniContext: To avoid something means to deliberately stay away from it or prevent it from happening. People avoid certain foods for health reasons, avoid dangerous neighborhoods late at night, or avoid difficult conversations out of fear of conflict. Sometimes avoiding a problem only delays it, since issues left unaddressed tend to resurface later in a worse form. Learning when to avoid risk and when to face it directly is an important part of making good decisions.

examples: She wasn't aware that the meeting had been moved to a different room.
او آگاه نبود که جلسه به اتاق دیگری منتقل شده است.
Being aware of your surroundings is especially important when walking alone at night.
آگاه بودن از محیط اطراف هنگام راه رفتن تنها در شب اهمیت زیادی دارد.
The company became aware of the security flaw only after customers started complaining.
این شرکت تنها پس از اینکه مشتریان شروع به شکایت کردند، از نقص امنیتی آگاه شد.
miniContext: Someone who is aware knows about or notices something, whether it's a fact, a danger, or a subtle change in their environment. Being aware of your own emotions can help you react more calmly in stressful situations, and being aware of a problem is usually the first step toward fixing it. Companies try to stay aware of changing customer needs so they don't fall behind competitors. The opposite of being aware is being oblivious, missing things that are often right in front of you.

examples: The recipe calls for a small quantity of salt, just half a teaspoon.
این دستور پخت به مقدار کمی نمک نیاز دارد، فقط نیم قاشق چای‌خوری.
The factory produces a large quantity of bottled water every single day.
کارخانه هر روز مقدار زیادی آب بطری‌شده تولید می‌کند.
Quality matters more than quantity when it comes to choosing good friends.
وقتی صحبت از انتخاب دوستان خوب باشد، کیفیت مهم‌تر از مقدار است.
miniContext: Quantity refers to the amount or number of something, often measured in units like weight, volume, or count. A chef must measure the right quantity of each ingredient to make sure a recipe turns out correctly, and a store manager tracks the quantity of items left in stock. People frequently compare quantity to quality, pointing out that having a large quantity of something isn't always better than having a smaller amount of higher value. Understanding quantity helps in everything from cooking to business planning.

examples: The old house has a certain appeal, even though it needs a lot of repairs.
آن خانه قدیمی جذابیت خاصی دارد، حتی اگر به تعمیرات زیادی نیاز داشته باشد.
His lawyer filed an appeal after he was found guilty by the lower court.
وکیل او پس از آنکه در دادگاه پایین‌تر مجرم شناخته شد، درخواست تجدیدنظر ثبت کرد.
The charity's appeal for donations raised enough money to rebuild the damaged school.
درخواست کمک‌مالی این خیریه پول کافی برای بازسازی مدرسه آسیب‌دیده را جمع کرد.
miniContext: Appeal can describe the quality that makes something attractive or interesting, such as a product's appeal to younger customers, or it can refer to a formal request, like an appeal to a higher court after losing a case. A charity might launch an appeal asking the public for donations during a crisis. Something can also simply lose its appeal over time, becoming less exciting the more familiar it feels. Context usually makes clear whether appeal means attraction or a formal request for reconsideration.

examples: The refugees lived in wretched conditions, with barely enough food or clean water.
پناهندگان در شرایطی اسفناک زندگی می‌کردند، با غذا و آب تمیز به‌سختی کافی.
He felt wretched after betraying his best friend's trust for no good reason.
او بعد از خیانت بی‌دلیل به اعتماد بهترین دوستش، احساس بدبختی و شرمندگی می‌کرد.
The abandoned building was a wretched sight, with broken windows and collapsing walls.
آن ساختمان متروکه منظره‌ای اسفناک بود، با پنجره‌های شکسته و دیوارهای فروریخته.
miniContext: Something wretched is in an extremely poor, miserable, or pitiful condition, often provoking sympathy or disgust. Wretched living conditions, such as overcrowded shelters without basic sanitation, highlight severe human suffering. People can also feel wretched emotionally, overwhelmed by guilt, shame, or despair after a painful mistake. Whether describing a place, a feeling, or a person's situation, wretched always points to a level of hardship that goes beyond ordinary difficulty.

examples: The winter in that region is extremely harsh, with temperatures dropping far below freezing.
زمستان در آن منطقه بسیار سخت است و دما به‌شدت زیر نقطه انجماد می‌رود.
Her manager's harsh criticism during the meeting left her feeling embarrassed in front of everyone.
انتقاد سخت و تندِ مدیرش در طول جلسه او را در مقابل همه شرمنده کرد.
The desert's harsh sunlight forced travelers to rest during the hottest hours of the day.
نور خشن و شدید خورشید در بیابان مسافران را مجبور می‌کرد در گرم‌ترین ساعات روز استراحت کنند.
miniContext: Something harsh is severe, unpleasant, or difficult to endure, whether describing weather, criticism, or living conditions. A harsh climate can make survival a daily struggle, while harsh words from someone you trust can hurt far more than a stranger's insult. Rules can also be described as harsh when they seem unfairly strict, such as a harsh punishment for a minor mistake. Softening a harsh reality usually requires either changing the situation itself or finding a gentler way to express difficult truths.

examples: It was a terrible misfortune that the flight was canceled right before their long-awaited vacation.
بدشانسی بزرگی بود که پرواز درست پیش از تعطیلاتی که مدت‌ها منتظرش بودند، لغو شد.
He had the misfortune of losing his job the same week his car broke down.
او بدشانسی این را داشت که همان هفته‌ای ماشینش خراب شد، شغلش را هم از دست بدهد.
Despite her many misfortunes, she never lost her sense of humor or hope.
با وجود مصیبت‌های زیادی که او تجربه کرد، هیچ‌وقت حس شوخ‌طبعی یا امیدش را از دست نداد.
miniContext: A misfortune is an unlucky event or a stroke of bad luck that causes difficulty or hardship. Losing a job, suffering an illness, or missing an important flight can all be described as a misfortune, especially when the timing makes things worse. Some people seem to attract one misfortune after another, while others manage to avoid serious trouble for years. However it strikes, misfortune is usually something that happens unexpectedly and is beyond a person's control.

examples: Many students opt to study abroad for at least one semester during college.
بسیاری از دانش‌آموزان ترجیح می‌دهند حداقل یک ترم در دوران دانشگاه در خارج از کشور تحصیل کنند.
She decided to opt for the cheaper flight, even though it included two layovers.
او تصمیم گرفت پرواز ارزان‌تر را انتخاب کند، حتی با وجود اینکه دو توقف میانی داشت.
If you don't want to receive marketing emails, you can opt out at any time.
اگر نمی‌خواهید ایمیل‌های تبلیغاتی دریافت کنید، می‌توانید هر زمان که خواستید انصراف دهید.
miniContext: To opt means to make a choice between different options, usually after some consideration. People opt for one career path over another based on their interests and goals, and companies let customers opt into or opt out of certain services like email newsletters. The word often appears in phrases like opt for or opt out, both describing a deliberate decision rather than something that just happens by default. Choosing to opt for a particular path always implies that other alternatives were available.

examples: After being scammed once, she remained wary of any offer that seemed too good to be true.
پس از آنکه یک بار کلاه‌بردار سرش کلاه گذاشت، او نسبت به هر پیشنهادی که خیلی خوب به نظر می‌رسید محتاط و هوشیار باقی ماند.
The dog stayed wary of strangers, backing away whenever someone new approached.
سگ نسبت به غریبه‌ها هوشیار باقی ماند و هر وقت کسی جدید نزدیک می‌شد، عقب می‌رفت.
Investors have grown wary about the company's claims after several promises went unfulfilled.
سرمایه‌گذاران پس از آنکه چند وعده عملی نشد، نسبت به ادعاهای این شرکت محتاط شده‌اند.
miniContext: Someone who is wary feels cautious and slightly suspicious, usually because of a past experience or a sense that something isn't quite right. A wary shopper double-checks reviews before buying from an unfamiliar website, and a wary animal keeps its distance from anything unfamiliar. Being wary isn't the same as being paranoid; it simply means staying alert rather than blindly trusting every situation. Over time, repeated disappointment or betrayal often makes people more wary than they used to be.

examples: They rolled a keg of beer into the backyard for the graduation party.
آن‌ها یک بشکه کوچک آبجو را برای جشن فارغ‌التحصیلی به حیاط پشتی غلتاندند.
The old keg in the cellar had been used for storing cider decades ago.
آن بشکه کوچک قدیمی در زیرزمین دهه‌ها پیش برای نگهداری سیدر استفاده می‌شد.
The brewery ships its craft beer in small kegs to local restaurants every week.
کارخانه آبجوسازی هر هفته آبجوی دست‌ساز خود را در بشکه‌های کوچک به رستوران‌های محلی ارسال می‌کند.
miniContext: A keg is a small barrel, usually made of metal or wood, most often used for storing and serving beer. Bars and breweries rely on kegs to keep beer fresh and carbonated until it's poured into a glass. At large parties, a keg often becomes the center of attention, with guests taking turns filling their cups. Though traditionally associated with beer, a keg can technically hold other liquids too, such as cider or wine, especially in older or historical contexts.

examples: A balanced diet helps nourish the body and keep the immune system strong.
یک رژیم غذایی متعادل به تغذیه بدن و حفظ قدرت سیستم ایمنی کمک می‌کند.
Farmers add fertilizer to the soil to nourish the crops throughout the growing season.
کشاورزان کود به خاک اضافه می‌کنند تا محصولات را در طول فصل رشد تغذیه کنند.
Reading often and widely can nourish a child's imagination in powerful ways.
خواندن مکرر و متنوع می‌تواند به شکل قدرتمندی تخیل کودک را تغذیه و پرورش دهد.
miniContext: To nourish means to provide what is needed for someone or something to grow, stay healthy, or develop well. Food nourishes the body, giving it energy and essential nutrients, while supportive relationships nourish a person's emotional well-being. Farmers nourish their soil with nutrients so that crops grow strong and plentiful. The word is often used beyond just food, describing anything that helps something flourish, from nourishing a friendship to nourishing a creative talent.

examples: After years of struggling, the former addict finally celebrated five years of sobriety.
پس از سال‌ها کشمکش، آن معتاد سابق سرانجام پنج سال پاکی خود را جشن گرفت.
The documentary followed the daily life of a heroin addict trying to recover.
این مستند زندگی روزمره یک معتاد به هروئین را دنبال می‌کرد که در حال تلاش برای بهبودی بود.
He jokingly calls himself a coffee addict because he can't start his day without it.
او به شوخی خودش را یک معتاد به قهوه می‌نامد، چون نمی‌تواند روزش را بدون آن شروع کند.
miniContext: An addict is someone who has developed a strong, often uncontrollable dependence on a substance or behavior, such as drugs, alcohol, or gambling. Becoming an addict usually happens gradually, as the body and mind grow increasingly dependent on the temporary relief or pleasure a substance provides. Treatment programs try to help an addict break free from this cycle through therapy, support groups, and sometimes medication. The word is also used loosely and humorously, as when someone calls themselves a chocolate addict simply because they love it so much.
